newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Dutch, Israeli banks in Turkmenistan gas loan.
newsitem.headline: Dutch, Israeli banks in Turkmenistan gas loan.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN-AMRO NV and Israel's Bank Hapoalim will will be lead lenders in an international consortium to finance development of a gas booster station in Turkmenistan, Hapolaim said on Monday.

Hapolaim said ABN-AMRO was mandated by Turkmenistan's State Economic Bank of Foreign Affairs to head to consortium financing the $180 million, three-year project. Hapoalim will lend $40 million of the total, with guarantees by the Israeli government's Foreign Trade Risks Corp.

Chief contractor for the project is Israel's Bateman Engineering Group, with most of the equipment coming from the United States, and engineering services from Israel and the Czech Republic, Hapoalim said.
"It is the first time that a leading international bank, such as ABN-AMRO, has joined forces with an Israeli bank to finance a project of this scale outside of Israel," Hapoalim said in a statement.
